Who we are

UrbanGO combines three complementary areas: TVDE, express delivery, and passenger and commercial vehicle rental.

We support drivers who want to work with Uber and Bolt, businesses that need fast deliveries, and people or companies looking for flexible rentals.

Our approach

Straightforward information, personal support and a team available seven days a week.
